description: List the user's notes, pinned first and then most recently updated, as id and title, with the folder each is filed in. Use when they ask what notes exist rather than for particular words, and when a title is enough to find the one they mean. Can list one folder, or the archive. Locked notes appear with their title hidden.

archived.description: true to list the archived notes instead of the others. Archived notes are left out of the list otherwise, though search_notes still finds them.

folder_id.description: Only the notes filed directly in this folder, as returned by list_folders. "none" for the notes in no folder. Omit for every note.

offset.description: How many notes to skip, for the next page of a long list. The list says when there are more.

name: scratchpad_list_notes
title: List notes
